recipe.visualDefinition: A vertical composition featuring a central, jagged-edged collage of high-contrast, sepia-toned character portraits emerging from a white textured background. The collage is anchored at the bottom by a stylized animal skull, with a large, brooding male face dominating the top. Below the central image, bold, distressed sans-serif typography is arranged in a tight, asymmetrical block.
coreVisualRelationships: Scale hierarchy between the large top portrait and smaller supporting figures
Contrast between the warm, dark sepia collage and the cool, off-white negative space
Vertical alignment between the central skull anchor and the typographic block below
Textural continuity between the distressed photo edges and the weathered font treatment
coreInvariants: Jagged, torn-paper aesthetic for the central image cluster

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Central vertical axis; primary subject at 40% scale at the top, tapering down to smaller figures and a skull at the center.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: A dark, symmetrical animal skull positioned at the bottom center of the image collage.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Top-down flow starting from the large face, moving through the character cluster to the skull, and terminating at the bold title text.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Expansive off-white space surrounding the central vertical column, creating a 'floating' effect.

colorSystem.contrastColorRole: Deep Sepia and Black (Subject shadows and Typography)
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: Low saturation with extreme value contrast; highlights are blown out to match the background, while shadows are crushed to black.
paletteRestrictions: No gradients outside of the photo-collage area

letterConstructionRules: Rough, eroded edges simulating woodblock or stamp printing
characterSpecificRedesigns: Letters are vertically stretched to varying degrees to fit the interlocking block layout

composition.overlap: Words are nested into each other's negative space
composition.relationshipToImage: Separated by white space, acting as a base

typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Distressed display face for impact paired with a clean, widely-spaced secondary face for legibility.

candidateDirections.reason: Matches the condensed, bold uppercase structure.
Provides the necessary organic erosion and grit.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Create a vertical collage of 5-7 character portraits in a high-contrast sepia duotone style. The edges of the collage should be jagged and torn. Place a large brooding face at the top and a dark animal skull at the bottom center. Set this entire element against a textured off-white paper background with visible grain.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add a stacked block of distressed, extra-condensed black sans-serif text below the skull. The words should be nested together with very tight leading. Add a single line of widely-spaced, clean geometric sans-serif text at the very bottom.

verificationChecks: Is the color palette strictly limited to sepia, black, and off-white?
Does the central collage have jagged, non-linear edges?
Is the main title text distressed and condensed?
Is there significant negative space on the left and right sides?

adjustableVariables: Number of characters in the collage
Level of distress on the typography
Amount of grain in the background texture
postGenerationChecks: Ensure the skull is the lowest point of the image collage.
Verify the title text is stacked and not a single horizontal line.
Check that the background texture is consistent across the white space.
Confirm the high-contrast lighting on the faces (deep shadows).
recipe.reuseFormula: Combine high-contrast duotone character photography with jagged collage edges and distressed condensed typography on a textured paper background for a gritty, cinematic look.
